questions.text: How many marbles could you fit inside a passenger lift?
questions.explanation: Usable volume ÷ the space each marble really takes up (its own volume plus the gaps around it) ≈ 1.49 million.
reasoning: A passenger lift car is about 1.6 × 1.4 × 2.3 m ≈ 5 m³.
A glass marble is about 16 mm across: about 2.14 cm³ each.
They fill only about 64% of the space; the rest is gaps.
questions.fact: Randomly poured balls fill about 64% of a space; even the best possible arrangement only reaches 74%, as Kepler guessed and a computer proof confirmed in 1998.
